definitions.explanation: the ability to perceive things beyond the five physical senses

examples.japanese: {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん}で{危険|きけん}を{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I sensed danger with my sixth sense.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{六感|ろっかん}が{鋭|するど}い。
examples.english: She has a sharp sixth sense.

examples.japanese: {六感|ろっかん}を{信|しん}じて{行動|こうどう}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to act on my intuition.

notes:
FULL EXPRESSION:
More commonly said as {第|だい}{六感|ろっかん} (the sixth sense).

THE FIVE SENSES ({五感|ごかん}):
- {視覚|しかく} - sight
- {聴覚|ちょうかく} - hearing
- {嗅覚|きゅうかく} - smell
- {味覚|みかく} - taste
- {触覚|しょっかく} - touch

SYNONYMS:
- {直感|ちょっかん} - intuition (more common in everyday speech)
- {勘|かん} - intuition; hunch (casual)
